description: This file contains integration tests for the 'sessions_yield' orchestration in a TypeScript project. The tests verify the correct behavior of session state management, particularly around yielding and tool calls, using a testing framework (Vitest). It imports multiple modules for mocking, fixture setup, and session handling, and defines several test cases to ensure the session behaves as expected under different scenarios.

methods.name: loadRunOverflowCompactionHarness
methods.description: Asynchronous function that loads the testing harness for overflow compaction runs used in the tests.

methods.name: mockedGlobalHookRunner.hasHooks
methods.description: Mock method to determine if global hooks are present, used to simulate environment conditions.

methods.name: mockedRunEmbeddedAttempt.mockReset
methods.description: Resets the mocked function before each test to ensure test isolation.

methods.name: mockedRunEmbeddedAttempt.mockResolvedValueOnce
methods.description: Sets up the mock to resolve with a specific test result once.

methods.name: makeAttemptResult
methods.description: Utility to create a simulated attempt result with specified properties for testing.

methods.name: runEmbeddedPiAgent
methods.description: Main function under test that executes the embedded Pi agent with given parameters.

methods.name: isEmbeddedPiRunActive
methods.description: Checks if the embedded Pi session identified by sessionId is currently active.

methods.name: queueEmbeddedPiMessage
methods.description: Attempts to enqueue a message to the embedded Pi session; returns false if message delivery must take a direct path.
